name: Euro-OS
description: Euro-OS is a desktop operating system built from scratch in Rust, with an integrated office suite, sovereign AI agents, support for 24 European languages, and full-disk encryption enabled by default. It ships with zero telemetry and fully open code, positioned as an everyday desktop rather than a specialized security distribution.

owner.name: GoTrust BV
owner.description: GoTrust builds a connected stack of European-first products: your workplace, your business ops, your monitoring, all the way down to the operating system. Your data stays home. Your software stops being a chore.
